title: Judicial review.
bodyText: Any person aggrieved by the order of the department of labor and industrial relations shall be entitled to judicial review as provided by section 91-14.
bodyHtml: §378-36  Judicial review.  Any person aggrieved by the order of the department of labor and industrial relations shall be entitled to judicial review as provided by section 91-14. [L 1967, c 22, pt of §1; HRS §378-36]
